why: Canonicalization output now prefers non-negative tracking utilities, changing suggested output.
Turns a crash on invalid candidate characters into working behavior.
Change is to @tailwindcss/webpack, not tailwindcss.
Canonicalization now collapses arbitrary values into shorthand utilities.
Canonicalization now collapses border side utilities into shorthand.
Canonicalization now collapses scroll-margin side utilities into shorthand.
Canonicalization now collapses scroll-padding side utilities into shorthand.
Canonicalization now collapses overflow-x/y into overflow-*.
Canonicalization now collapses overscroll-x/y into overscroll-*.
placeholder-* utilities now read a different theme variable, so existing theme configs behave differently.
Prevents files being emptied when the upgrade is killed, a robustness bug fix.
The upgrade tool now uses config.content to decide which files to migrate.
The upgrade command now skips git-ignored files it previously migrated.
Env files are now ignored by default in content scanning, so classes in them are no longer picked up.
Canonicalization now migrates overflow-ellipsis to text-ellipsis.
Canonicalization now migrates start-* utilities to inset-s-*.
Canonicalization now migrates end-* utilities to inset-e-*.
Canonicalization now moves the minus sign inside arbitrary values.
Canonicalization now moves the negative sign outside arbitrary values.
Scanning performance improvement with no observable output change.
The standalone CLI now honors NODE_PATH, which people may already set, changing module resolution.
Change is to @tailwindcss/vite, not tailwindcss.
New utility; older versions simply don't generate it.
New scrollbar-width and scrollbar-color utilities; older versions ignore unknown classes.
New scrollbar-gutter utilities; older versions ignore unknown classes.
New zoom-* utilities; older versions simply generate no CSS for them.
New tab-* utilities; older versions ignore unknown classes without error.
@variant with stacked variants is newly accepted; older versions reject it with an error.
@variant with compound variants is newly accepted; older versions reject it with an error.
New --default(…) inside --value/--modifier in functional @utility; older versions reject the unknown function.
@plugin now resolves the JS entry as intended instead of failing or picking the wrong file.
Relative @import/@plugin paths resolving correctly matches documented behavior.
CSS files with @variant not being processed by the Vite plugin was a bug.
Import resolution now works when from is missing, fixing a failure.
Canonicalization bug fix preserving significant whitespace.
Canonicalization output fix for readability and correctness.
Canonicalization fix that avoids incorrect unit normalization.
Canonicalization now suggests has-[…] for arbitrary :has() variants; a suggestion fix, not a change to code written for the previous version.
Upgrade tool no longer corrupts inline style attributes; a bug fix.
Multiple @utility definitions with the same name now work instead of conflicting.
Exports a missing type to fix type inference errors.
Bare legacy start/end utilities no longer generate CSS, changing output for existing usage.
Functional @utility definitions without --value(…) are now rejected.
Canonicalization fix preserving required whitespace around operators.
New CLI flag; older versions reject the unknown option.
Only removes deprecation warnings on Node 26+.
Turns a crash in canonicalization into working behavior.
@apply with CSS mixins is newly allowed; previously it errored.
not-* negating @container queries correctly is a bug fix to expected behavior.
drop-shadow color utilities now work with calc() values as expected.
Removes spurious sourcemap warnings; no behavior change users code against.
Installation in Rspack projects no longer errors on a missing peer dependency.
Canonicalization no longer suggests invalid calc expressions; corrects a bug.
Canonicalization bug fix avoiding wrong suggestions for arbitrary lengths.
Watch mode now recovers from a deleted and restored dependency.
Standalone binaries are no longer scanned for class candidates; a scanning bug fix.
Candidates from Twig addClass/removeClass are now extracted, as expected.
Preprocessors no longer crash on invalid UTF-8.
@variant inside addBase turns an error into working behavior.
Symlinked @source globs are preserved; bug fix.
Later @source rules re-including files excluded by @source not matches documented ordering.
Upgrade tool no longer emits invalid @utility rules.
Inset shadow transitions now work correctly; bug fix.
Explicitly referenced @source directories are scanned even if git-ignored, matching documented behavior.
Fixes @source globs scanning too many files; bug fix.
Canonicalization bug fix avoiding high-precision folded values.
Correct ESM type declarations are now served; resolves a typing bug.
Generated CSS for spacing utilities like m-0 changes from calc(var(--spacing) * 0) to 0, altering output.
Generated CSS for spacing utilities like m-1 changes from calc(var(--spacing) * 1) to var(--spacing), altering output.
Bare spacing values for auto-rows-*/auto-cols-* are newly supported; older versions don't generate them.
Fixes a Windows watch-mode crash.
Fixes a Deno crash in the Vite plugin.
Watch mode now rebuilds on input CSS change; bug fix.
Custom variants defined later now work in addBase @variant; error becomes working behavior.
Fixes a Vite HMR crash when scanned files are deleted.
Same class now emits font-size instead of color, changing output.
Restores documented @source scanning scope by not scanning unrelated siblings.
Fixes class extraction in Template Toolkit files so expected classes are found.
Fixes class extraction from Maud syntax.
Removes a spurious warning on valid @position-try rules.
Editor class suggestions now include named opacity modifiers, matching expected behavior.
Fixes type errors with newer PostCSS patch releases.
Makes --watch --poll work as intended; ambiguous whether new, but described as a fix to support existing flag.
Canonicalization now matches uppercase hex colors to theme colors, changing its output.
Preflight output no longer overrides Firefox's native iframe focus outline.
theme('colors.foo') now resolves correctly as documented.
Fractional opacity modifiers with named shadows now work as documented instead of failing.
Corrects selector parsing bug.
Rebuild now occurs when preprocessors change input, as expected.
CSS nesting now handled in browser build as expected.
Mixed achromatic colors in polar spaces now produce different hue output.
Optimized output changes from 0 to 0px.
Turns a load failure into working builds.
Preflight default font stacks changed, altering rendered fonts.
Upgrade tool no longer rewrites ignored files, as expected.
Ensures @source rules are scanned as documented.
Avoids unnecessary full page reloads in the Vite plugin.
